next.reason: 1985 GR3 is a presentation pointer: 'With the exception of the REPORT clause, all clauses within the file description entry for a report file' are those of the Sequential I-O module, i.e. they mean what they mean in a sequential FD. 2023 keeps that sharing: §2023:13.4.5.2 'Format 3 (report)' (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR8 'Format 3 is the file description entry for a report file') lists BLOCK CONTAINS, record-clause and CODE-SET, the same clauses of Format 1 (sequential), each defined once for every FD: §2023:13.18.10.4 GR1 (BLOCK CONTAINS), §2023:13.18.43.4 GR1 (RECORD), §2023:13.18.13.4 GR1 (CODE-SET). The loss of LABEL RECORDS/VALUE OF is a general-format matter carried by the FD format records, not by this pointer; a clause written in a 1985 report FD that 2023 still has means the same.
